points.text: (Thermal) energy per unit mass (to cause change of state).
(Energy transfer during) change of state between solid and liquid at constant temperature.

Any one from: rate of increase in mass (of beaker and water) is constant; level of water rises at a constant rate; volume of water (in beaker) increases at a constant rate; constant time between drops; constant rate of dripping
